title.text: Vell Glassworks · No. 1 Adit · shift log

contents.text: Kiln Three: bellows UP, flue DOWN, damper UP, then feed the firebox. Eight scoops, no less. — S.C.
Stillglass from the Deepcut rings when struck. The Keeper wants more of it than the mountain wants to give.
Keeper's orders: past the blue seam. Tobin says it will hold. I have told him what I think of the roof. — S. Crane, foreman
(Last entry, in another hand:) The bells are ringing in Hollin. The Deepcut is down. Eleven.
